title: Learning Globally Reusable Skills for Coding Agents
title_zh: 为编码智能体学习全局可复用技能
abstract_en: Automated skill evolution enables Large Language Model (LLM) agents to continuously improve without expensive retraining. However, existing approaches typically treat skill evolution as a sequence of local updates, overlooking relationships among skills and often producing overfitted skill updates that fail to generalize across tasks. We propose GSE, a globalized skill evolution framework that jointly optimizes skill compatibility and skill generalization. To preserve consistency across the skill bank, GSE maintains a Skill Relation Graph (SRG) that explicitly models and co-evolves inter-skill relationships. To improve generalization, GSE performs cluster-based skill consolidation to abstract reusable capabilities from local updates and employs replay-driven verification to prevent overfitting and behavioral regressions. We evaluate GSE on two representative software engineering tasks: bug-revealing test generation and false-positive bug report filtering. Across two state-of-the-art coding agents, OpenHands and mini-SWE-agent, GSE consistently achieves the best precision, recall, and F1-score. Compared with existing evolution techniques, GSE improves precision and recall by 6.1%~34.1% and 31.8%~180.0% for test generation, and by 15.4%~96.4% and 13.1%~19.8% for false-positive filtering. Deployment on an internal industrial agent further yields a 61.4% improvement in F1-score, demonstrating the effectiveness and generalizability of GSE for evolving effective skills.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 GSE，一个面向 LLM 编码智能体的全局化技能演化框架，旨在解决现有技能演化方法只做局部更新、忽视技能间关系、容易过拟合且跨任务泛化不足的问题。GSE 通过维护 Skill Relation Graph（SRG）显式建模并共同演化技能之间的依赖与兼容关系，从而保持技能库的一致性；同时采用基于聚类的技能整合，从局部更新中抽象出可复用能力，并通过 replay-driven verification 防止过拟合和行为退化。论文在两类软件工程任务上评估：bug-revealing test generation 和 false-positive bug report filtering。结果显示，在 OpenHands 与 mini-SWE-agent 两个先进编码智能体上，GSE 在 precision、recall 和 F1-score 上均取得最佳表现；在内部工业智能体部署中也带来 61.4% 的 F1-score 提升，表明其对有效技能演化具有良好的有效性与泛化性。
key_points_zh: 提出 GSE，将技能演化从局部更新扩展为全局优化，同时关注 skill compatibility 与 skill generalization。
引入 Skill Relation Graph（SRG）显式建模技能间关系，并在演化过程中共同更新技能及其关系，减少技能库内部冲突。
通过 cluster-based skill consolidation 从局部经验中抽象通用技能，并用 replay-driven verification 抑制过拟合和行为回退。
在 bug-revealing test generation 与 false-positive bug report filtering 两类任务上，GSE 在 OpenHands 和 mini-SWE-agent 中均取得最佳 precision、recall 与 F1-score。
相较已有演化方法，GSE 在测试生成和误报过滤任务上显著提升 precision 与 recall，并在内部工业智能体中实现 61.4% 的 F1-score 增益。

llm_assessment.comment: Strong in-scope work on coding-agent skill evolution with reusable skill graphs, consolidation, and replay-driven verification.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇高度相关的代码智能体技能演化论文，结合了可复用技能图、技能整合和回放验证。
